summary: Iteration 3 — Pro tier + Terms + Phone signup. BACKEND: 14/14 pytest tests PASS (100%): /api/legal/terms contains Callistus Moses/Msafe/NOT a lawyer/INDEMNITY; /api/billing/pricing returns ₹999 one_time with 6 features; /api/auth/register rejects terms_accepted=false (400) and missing phone (422); successful register returns user with phone/is_pro:false/terms_accepted:true/terms_version/terms_accepted_at; /api/auth/me exposes all new keys; /api/auth/accept-terms works; /api/chat/stream persists both user+assistant roles ordered correctly; /api/billing/checkout returns 401 without auth and 500 with placeholder Stripe key (EXPECTED); /api/webhooks/stripe returns 400 on malformed body; /api/health returns terms_version '1.0'. FRONTEND (390x844): Signup screen renders all required testIDs; submit blocked without terms with correct error 'You must accept the Terms & Conditions'; terms-modal opens with 'Callistus Moses' & 'NOT a lawyer'; Upgrade screen renders pro-price ₹999, features, disclaimer, upgrade-cta-button correctly. CRITICAL BLOCKER: (tabs)/index.tsx (Chat screen) RED-SCREENS with 'ReferenceError: user is not defined' immediately after signup — component references user/router/showBanner/setShowBanner without declaring them (see line 22 destructures only {token, language, model} but lines 177, 189-202 use user?.is_pro, showBanner, setShowBanner, router.push). Because chat screen crashes and remains mounted, could not reach Settings tab to verify pro-upsell-card/view-terms/profile-phone/settings-terms-modal in this run.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: 'user is not defined' at render. Component destructures only { token, language, model } from useAuth() on line 22 but uses user?.is_pro (line 177, 201), showBanner/setShowBanner (lines 189, 195), and router.push (line 202) which are never declared. Causes RED SCREEN immediately when navigating into (tabs) after signup/login. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:22 & 177

integration_issues.issue: Signup POST succeeds and token is stored, but the target chat screen throws ReferenceError so the user sees an 'Uncaught Error: user is not defined' overlay instead of the chat UI. Disclaimer banner (testID='disclaimer-banner') and dismiss-banner therefore cannot be verified end-to-end.

action_items: URGENT: Fix /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx ChatScreen — add `user`, `refreshUser` (if needed) to the useAuth() destructure on line 22; add `const router = useRouter();`; add `const [showBanner, setShowBanner] = useState(true);`. critical_code_review_comments: (tabs)/index.tsx is missing three declarations that its JSX uses — a classic 'variable-used-but-not-declared' regression. TypeScript should have caught this; check tsconfig strict flags / Metro type-check pipeline.
chat_stream save_assistant() runs inside finally; if the client disconnects mid-stream the coroutine may still complete — good. But there's no timeout guard; long LLM hangs could pile up. Not urgent.

STRIPE_API_KEY presence check only guards checkout — /billing/verify also calls stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve; if the key becomes empty at runtime verify would 500 with a less friendly message. Consider mirroring the not-configured guard.

terms_acknowledgements audit collection has no unique index on (user_id, terms_version, source) — a user tapping 'accept terms' twice will create duplicate audit rows. Acceptable for audit purposes but flag it.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (Chat red-screen): During iteration-3 refactor, new features (Pro badge in header, dismissible disclaimer banner, chat-upgrade-cta banner, router.push('/upgrade')) were added to /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx JSX, but the corresponding hook additions were never made — the destructure on line 22 remained `const { token, language, model } = useAuth();` (missing `user`), `useRouter` was not called, and `useState` for `showBanner` was not declared. First render triggers `user?.is_pro` → 'user is not defined' → RN web ErrorBoundary shows red screen. REPRO: 1) Register/login any user 2) App auto-navigates to /(tabs) 3) Red screen 'Uncaught Error: user is not defined' at app/(tabs)/index.tsx:177:14. MITIGATION: add these three lines near the top of ChatScreen — `const { token, user, language, model } = useAuth();`, `const router = useRouter();`, `const [showBanner, setShowBanner] = useState(true);`. Ensure `useRouter` is imported (already is: line 5).
